summary.text: Debbie Sariñana, listed by Ballotpedia as Debra Sariñana, is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 21 who took office in 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Sariñana's professional experience includes working as a math teacher at Manzano High School, and she also served in the U.S. Air Force.

In the 2025-2026 session, Sariñana serves on the Appropriations and Finance Committee and the Commerce & Economic Development Committee, and is vice chair of the Energy, Environment and Natural Resources Committee.
